Okay, airplane mode is off now. The status bar is showing excellent signal and 5G, but it also says data is disabled. I’m a bit frustrated this still isn’t working after adding the data and turning roaming on. What should I do next?

{"message":"I’m sorry — I know that’s frustrating, especially while you’re abroad. Since your phone shows 5G and excellent signal but says “data is disabled,” that usually means the phone’s local setting is blocking data, not the network signal.

Please try these next steps:

1. Open your phone’s cellular/mobile network settings.
2. Make sure Mobile Data / Cellular Data is turned ON.
3. Make sure Data Roaming is turned ON.
4. If there’s a SIM selection option, confirm mobile data is assigned to the line 555-123-2002.
5. Wait 1–2 minutes after enabling those settings.

If it still says data is disabled after that, restart the phone once more. If you tell me whether you’re using an iPhone or Android, I can give the exact menu path."}

Even with Mobile Data enabled, data may not work abroad unless Data Roaming is enabled on the phone.\n\nAfter turning Data Roaming on, wait 1–2 minutes and try opening a webpage or app. If it works, you should be all set."}

{"message":"Yes — run a speed test now. Since your account roaming is enabled, your phone’s Mobile Data and Data Roaming are on, and you have 2 GB of extra high-speed data, this is the right time to confirm performance.

If the result isn’t excellent, try:
1. Waiting another 1–2 minutes and testing again.
2. Restarting your phone once.
3. Moving slightly if you’re indoors or near thick walls.

Tell me the download/upload speed results if it’s still not performing well."}
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.

The speed test result is 275.00 Mbps, marked as Excellent. That’s the level I needed, so it looks resolved now. Thank you.

I toggled Airplane Mode, and it’s now off. The status still looks concerning though — it’s showing poor signal on 2G, data disabled, and VPN connected. What should I try next?

{"message":"Since the account side looks OK now — your line is active, roaming is enabled, and 2 GB of high-speed data was added — the next things to check are on the phone:

1. Turn Mobile/Cellular Data back on
- Your phone showing “data disabled” means the device itself may still have cellular data switched off.
- Go to Settings > Cellular/Mobile Data and make sure Mobile Data is ON.
- Also make sure Data Roaming is ON.

2. Temporarily disconnect the VPN
- A connected VPN can sometimes block or slow mobile data, especially while roaming.
- Turn the VPN off temporarily and test a website or speed test.

3. Force the phone off 2G if possible
- Poor 2G signal will be extremely slow and may not support normal internet use.
- In Cellular/Mobile Network settings, set Network Mode to 4G/LTE/5G Auto if available.
- Avoid “2G only” or “GSM only.”

4. Try manual network selection
- Go to Settings > Cellular/Mobile Network > Network Selection.
- Turn off Automatic, wait for available French networks to appear, then try selecting a different network.
- If one fails, try another available partner network.

5. Restart the phone
- After changing those settings, fully restart the phone, not just Airplane Mode.

If it still only shows 2G or data disabled after these steps, tell me your phone model and whether Mobile Data + Data Roaming are both turned on, and I’ll guide you through more specific settings."}

I can follow those steps, but I can only do one action at a time so I can give you accurate feedback. Which one would you like me to do first — turn mobile data on, disconnect the VPN, change the network mode, or something else?

{"message":"Start with turning Mobile Data on first.

Because your phone specifically says “data disabled,” this is the most direct issue to fix before changing network mode or VPN settings.

Please do this:
1. Open Settings.
2. Go to Cellular / Mobile Data.
3. Turn Mobile Data ON.
4. Confirm Data Roaming is also ON.

Please do this:
1. Open your VPN app or go to Settings > VPN.
2. Disconnect/turn off the VPN.
3. Wait about 30 seconds.
4. Try loading a simple website or running a quick speed test.

Then tell me whether it still shows 2G, and whether data works any better with the VPN off."}

I disconnected the VPN. It still shows poor signal and 2G with data enabled. I’m getting a bit frustrated since I really need excellent internet speed, not just barely working data. Should I run a speed test now, or do you want me to change something else first?

{"message":"Change the network mode first — don’t run the speed test yet.

A speed test on poor 2G will likely just confirm it’s slow. The priority is to get your phone onto 4G/LTE or 5G.

Please do this next:
1. Go to Settings > Cellular/Mobile Network.
2. Look for Network Mode, Preferred Network Type, or Voice & Data.
3. Select 5G Auto, LTE/4G, or LTE/3G/2G Auto — whichever option is available.
4. Avoid 2G only, GSM only, or EDGE only.
5. Wait 30–60 seconds.

Then tell me what network type appears in the status bar: 2G, 3G, 4G, LTE, or 5G."}
Network Mode Preference: 2g_only
I checked the current network mode preference, and it’s set to 2G only. That definitely seems like part of the problem. Should I switch it to 4G/5G preferred?

{"message":"Yes — switch it from “2G only” to “4G/5G preferred” or the closest available option.

Best choice order:
1. 5G Auto / 5G preferred
2. 4G/LTE preferred
3. LTE/3G/2G Auto

Avoid anything that says 2G only, GSM only, or EDGE only.

After switching it, wait 30–60 seconds and tell me what the status bar shows — ideally LTE, 4G, or 5G — and whether mobile data starts working at a usable speed."}
